column2: Description
Search and list campaigns with filtering by name, status, type (one-time, recurring, segment triggered, event triggered, live content), author, tags, and more. Supports pagination and sorting.
Retrieve the complete, unfiltered configuration of a campaign including all fields preserved — triggers, conditions, experiment groups, scheduling, and settings.
Retrieve campaign information with smart AI filtering — returns only the fields matching your intent for a lightweight, token-efficient response.

Primary tool for campaign performance metrics including sends, opens, clicks, conversions, revenue, and rates. Supports filtering by channel, campaign, trigger, template, and time range. Also used for segment trends and recommended items reporting.
Create a new campaign shell (one-time, recurring, segment triggered, or event triggered). Use update_campaign after creation to add triggers, segments, and templates.
Add triggers, segments, templates, conditions, A/B tests, scheduling, and all configuration details to an existing campaign. Supports the full journey builder workflow.
List all customer segments with their names, types, and metadata.
Retrieve detailed configuration and filter criteria for a specific segment, including all V2 conditions and components.
Create a new Advanced (V2) segment with a root condition node. Add conditions afterward with update_segment_v2.

Update an existing V2 segment — add, modify, or delete conditions and components including user attributes, events, transactions, and segment references. Supports resource draft pointers for iterative editing.
Search and filter users by attributes, segments, or dynamic inline queries. Supports count only mode for funnel analysis, cohort sizing, and retention measurement.
Get user count at a specific V2 segment condition node — useful for debugging and verifying segment logic.
View the underlying query generated from segment conditions for debugging and optimization.
List email templates with optional filtering by name, tags, editor type, status, and author.
Retrieve detailed information about an email template including HTML content, settings, Liquid variables, and associated campaigns. Supports expanding shared assets inline.
Create a new email template with name, subject line, preheader, and HTML content.
Update an existing email template's subject, preheader, content, or recommendation settings.

Render a Liquid email template with personalizations and optionally generate a screenshot with AI-powered visual analysis. Supports rendering by user identifier, manual personalizations, or optimizer experiment context.
Fetch personalization context for a user and template, including product recommendations — used for Liquid template preview.
List push notification templates with filtering by name, tags, and author.
List SMS/MMS templates with filtering by name, tags, message type, and author.
List reusable content blocks (HTML, rich text, subject lines, visual editor blocks) with filtering by type, name, tags, and usage counts.
Retrieve detailed information about a specific shared asset including content, dependencies, and usage.
Get all email templates that reference a specific shared asset.
Search for customers by common identifiers — email, customer ID, phone, UUID, device ID, or cookie.
Retrieve an AI-optimized user profile with behavioral analytics, engagement patterns, and summary insights.
List all events and interactions for a specific customer with pagination support.
List all purchase transactions for a specific customer.
List all campaign interactions and messaging activity for a specific customer.
Retrieve comprehensive campaign activity history for a user within a date range.
Return the full segmentation schema including events, user attributes, transactions, operators, and timeline helpers. Supports output masking for large payloads (50K+ tokens).
Retrieve user attribute schema for building valid group by choices in audience insights and segmentation. Includes AI-powered smart filtering.
Get the data structure and available attributes/fields for customer records.
Get detailed schema for specific event types including available properties and data types.
Get the data structure and available fields for product catalog records.
Get the data structure and available fields for customer profiles.
Get a UI friendly schema with filter operators, event categories, and simplified score lists for recommendation authoring.
Retrieve the recommendation authoring schema with available filters, events, and data stores for building catalog item blocks.
Get usage statistics for all attributes across users, events, products, or user base — including campaign, segment, and template usage counts.
Check specific attributes (up to 40) for usage across campaigns, segments, templates, or count of users where the attribute is set.
Return active predictive scores, predictive affinities, computed attributes, and RFM definitions available for the account.
List all product catalogs with metadata to identify which catalog to search.
Search and filter catalog products by attributes like SKU, title, brand, category, price, and availability. Supports AND/OR/NOT conditions and pagination.
Get product details by SKU or product ID.
Get product details by internal UUID.
Get distribution statistics for product attribute values (e.g., category breakdown for purchase events).
List all recommendation schemes with names and configurations.
List recommendation schemes with enriched AI-generated descriptions and metadata.
Retrieve detailed configuration for a specific recommendation scheme including blocks and settings.
List recommendation block themes (recipes) with configurations and use cases. Supports smart filtering.
Get detailed configuration of a specific recommendation block theme.
Test and validate recommendation algorithms with real user data.
Retrieve personalized product recommendations for a specific customer.
Create a new recommendation algorithm using draft resource pointers or inline code.
Update an existing recommendation algorithm.
Compile Plasma code to validate syntax and generate personalization steps.
List optimizer opportunities and approval pending items — the main queue for optimization work. Filter by type (opportunity vs. approval pending).
Get full opportunity details including AI analysis, generated content, and scoring for a specific experiment group.
Check current status of the opportunity discovery pipeline for the account.
List optimization runs across the account with filtering by campaign type, status, significance, and pagination.
Get detailed information about a single optimization run including metrics, allocations, and results.
Get current optimizer state, configuration, active runs, and test allocations for an experiment group.
Retrieve the cached account level optimizer landscape summary.
List ranked content variants with ELO tournament scores and user feedback for an experiment group.
Render a single sample context for current, optimized, or custom content for an experiment.
Batch render candidate subject lines and preheaders against a selected sample context.
List stored AI analyses for an experiment group — the reasoning behind opportunity identification.
List saved standard reports filtered by name, insight type, author, or tags.
Fetch a single saved report with tags and metric details.
Create a reusable campaign performance report (chart or table) that can be added to dashboards. Supports multiple chart types, groupings, and time comparisons.
Update a saved report — rename, swap metrics, change filters, chart type, or visibility.
List dashboard shells filtered by name or author email.
Fetch a full dashboard including global filters, widgets, and notes.
Create a new dashboard shell. Add widgets and filters afterward with update_dashboard.
Update an existing dashboard — rename, adjust global filters, add/reorder/delete widgets, and edit notes.
List available performance metrics (sends, clicks, conversion rates, etc.) for campaign performance, user insights, recommendations, or segment trends.
Query customer analytics for audience composition by attributes, predictive scores, RFM tiers, and more.
Get event activity summary, counts, trends, and metadata for a specified time period.
Get transaction configuration including available events for a transaction type.
List and search onsite slots for live content campaigns with filtering by name, format, and active status.
Get detailed information about a specific onsite slot.
Create a new onsite slot for live content campaigns (HTML, JSON, or Landing Page format).
Retrieve personalized live content for a specific slot and user — useful for testing personalization.
List all promotions with status, values, expiration dates, and use type (single use or multi use).
List tag folders used for organizing campaigns, templates, segments, and other resources.
Get detailed information about a specific tag folder including tagged resources.
Get usage counts for tags within a folder, optionally filtered by resource type.
List audit trail records for understanding user behavior, investigating changes, and debugging. Filter by author, resource type, action, date range, and resource name.
Retrieve complete details of a specific change for deep investigation and understanding exact modifications.
Get account settings, feature flags, and configuration details.
Retrieve foundational account context notes — business description, email program analysis, campaign landscape, and brand voice analysis.
List all marketing insights for the account with filtering by status, insight type, and severity.
Get detailed information about a specific marketing insight including metrics, analysis, findings, and related resources.
Save a structured marketing insight with trend analysis, metrics, key findings, and by entity breakdowns.
Update an existing marketing insight.
List ideation proposals with optional filtering by name, status, and more.
Get detailed information about a specific ideation proposal.
Save a structured, data-backed ideation proposal with audience sizing, RICE scoring, execution plans, and resource mapping.
Update an existing proposal or record execution progress with step-by-step tracking and asset linking.
Generate chart images (line, bar, area, scatter, pie, histogram) from data you pass in.
Generate PDF reports from data with configurable layout, sections, charts, and styling.
Generate PowerPoint presentations from a predefined list of slides.
Generate Excel spreadsheets from data with configurable sheets, formatting, and totals.
List and search images in the account's image library.
Save an image from a URL to the account's image library.
Update image metadata including type and tags.
Analyze an image from a URL to extract information, describe content, or answer questions about visual elements.
Generate new images or edit existing ones.
Search Blueshift's Zendesk Help Center for documentation and guides.
Get full article content by ID with complete documentation.
Load domain reference documentation on demand for specialized knowledge — campaign analysis workflows, segment creation patterns, email template authoring, and more.
Generate a Blueshift dashboard link for any resource (segment, campaign, template, algorithm, report, dashboard, customer, etc.).
Generate random UUIDs for use in resource creation.
Create, fetch, or edit reusable server-managed drafts (segments, templates, algorithms) for iterative workflows.
Request temporary write permission in chat-based agent environments that support approval elicitations.
Search for and discover available tools by keyword or intent. Returns ranked matches with invocation hints.
Compress context and switch tool packs for long-running, multi-phase agent workflows. Preserves working memory across context boundaries.
Create or update the AGENTS.MD awareness document that is automatically injected into future sessions.
Research current information using Google Search for market intelligence and competitive context.
Create, list, fetch, comment on, and close GitHub issues in the Blueshift MCP tools repository. Blueshift internal use only.
Browse pages (InternalPages, PublicPages, ToolScripts).
Get details of a specific page.
Create an internal page.
Create an external page.
Update an internal page.
Update an external page.
Execute a page headlessly.
Execute a tool script headlessly.
Present a page to the user.
Soft-delete a page.
Get a personalized URL for a resource.
